about.page_description: A safe and inclusive community celebrating movement, gratitude, and shared effort — more than miles, we build spirit and well-being.
about.mission_text: [Ánimo] Run Club is born with the intention of creating a safe and inclusive space, where energy, respect, and community meet in every step. We foster healthy coexistence through movement, sharing the joy of running outdoors regardless of level or experience. Our mission is to celebrate what our bodies can do, be grateful for every day we can move, and strengthen bonds through shared effort. More than miles, we build community, spirit, and well-being.
about.mission_bullet_1: We create and cross bridges — together
about.mission_bullet_2: We run with gratitude and advance with spirit
about.mission_bullet_3: Where willpower motivates you and community sustains you
about.mission_bullet_4: ÁNIMO — a word with infinite meaning
about.vision_p1: To be a reference for an active, conscious, and supportive community, where running is not just a physical activity, but a way to reconnect with oneself, with others, and with the environment.
about.vision_p2: We want to inspire people of all ages to move from gratitude, enthusiasm, and mutual support.
about.vision_p3: We dream of a group that unites friends, families, parents and children, leading them to discover new paths, emotions, and personal capabilities.
about.vision_p4: Our purpose is clear: it's not about winning, but about participating, sharing, and growing together.
about.vision_p5: Every Sunday, we are that cry to the world that says: we are here, with you, to motivate you! ÁNIMO!
about.value_gratitude_text: We run with awareness of what our bodies can do and what they allow us to experience.
about.value_inclusion_text: Everyone is welcome here. Age, pace, or experience does not matter: every step counts.
about.value_community_text: We motivate each other. We celebrate big and small achievements, and we accompany each other in challenges.
about.value_passion_text: We don't look for speed, we look for purpose. Spirit is trained, just like legs and heart. Beyond the physical, we cultivate the mind: the courage to start, the patience to continue, and the satisfaction of not giving up.
about.documenting_1: At Ánimo Run Club we believe every step counts and every story deserves to be told. We love witnessing the evolution of our members.
about.documenting_2: Every runner is worthy of constant recognition and celebration.
about.documenting_3: We are committed to documenting and increasing the visibility of the individual and collective process, helping each member become a living inspiration for others. We want every person to recognize their own path, look at themselves with pride, and be a better version of themselves.
about.documenting_5: We love seeing the evolution of each member, personal growth, and spiritual increase. Each member deserves constant celebration for every step they take. Helping each one to be an inspiration to others and to recognize that they themselves arrived and are increasingly a better version of themselves.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Find answers to our most frequently asked questions below.
faq.orders_q1: How do I track my order?
faq.orders_a1: Once your order ships, you will receive an email with a tracking number. You can use it to track your package on the carrier's website.
faq.orders_q2: Can I cancel or modify my order?
faq.orders_a2: Orders can only be cancelled or modified within 1 hour of being placed. Please contact us immediately at info@animorunclub.com.
faq.shipping_a1: Standard shipping takes 5–7 business days. Expedited shipping (2–3 business days) and overnight options are available at checkout.
faq.shipping_a2: Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International orders typically arrive within 7–14 business days depending on the destination.
faq.shipping_a3: We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $100 within the US. International orders may be subject to customs duties and taxes.
faq.products_q1: How do I find my size?
faq.products_a1: Each product page includes a size guide with detailed measurements. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up for a more comfortable fit during runs.
faq.products_q2: How should I care for my gear?
faq.products_a2: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle and hang to dry. Avoid fabric softener and bleach to preserve performance fabrics.
faq.returns_a1: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging with tags attached.
faq.returns_q2: How long does a refund take?
faq.returns_a2: Once we receive and inspect your return, refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to your original payment method.

returns.title: Returns
returns.subtitle: We want you to love every piece. If something isn't right, here's how to return it.
returns.policy_days_text: You have 30 days from the delivery date to initiate a return.
returns.policy_condition_text: Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging with all tags attached.
returns.policy_exceptions_text: Final sale items, gift cards, and personalized products are not eligible for return.
returns.step1_desc: Email us at info@animorunclub.com with your order number and the item(s) you wish to return.
returns.step2_desc: We'll send you a prepaid return shipping label within 1–2 business days.
returns.step3_desc: Pack your item securely and drop it off at any authorized carrier location.
returns.step4_desc: Once we receive and inspect your return, your refund will be issued within 5–7 business days to your original payment method.
returns.exchanges_text: We don't offer direct exchanges. To get a different size or color, return your original item and place a new order. This ensures you get your new item as quickly as possible.

privacy_policy.heading: PRIVACY POLICY

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website, purchase our products, or interact with us in any other way.
privacy_policy.section_1_p2: Please read this policy carefully. If you disagree with its terms, please discontinue use of our site.
privacy_policy.section_2_p1: The data controller responsible for your personal information is Ánimo Run Club. You can reach us at:

privacy_policy.section_3_list_1_1: Name, email address, phone number, and postal address
privacy_policy.section_3_list_1_3: Billing and payment information (processed securely by our payment providers)
privacy_policy.section_3_list_1_5: Communications you send us, including support requests
privacy_policy.section_3_list_2_1: IP address, browser type, and operating system
privacy_policy.section_3_list_2_2: Pages visited, time spent on pages, and referring URLs
privacy_policy.section_3_list_3_1: Social media platforms when you connect your account or interact with our pages
privacy_policy.section_3_list_3_3: Fraud prevention and identity verification services
privacy_policy.section_4_p1: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
privacy_policy.section_4_list_2: Managing your account and providing customer support
privacy_policy.section_4_list_3: Sending order confirmations, shipping updates, and service notifications
privacy_policy.section_4_list_4: Sending marketing communications and newsletters, where you have given consent or where permitted by law
privacy_policy.section_4_list_5: Personalizing your browsing and shopping experience
privacy_policy.section_4_list_6: Improving our website, products, and services
privacy_policy.section_4_list_7: Detecting and preventing fraud or unauthorized activity
privacy_policy.section_5_p1: Where applicable under data protection law (including the GDPR), we process your personal information on the following legal bases:
privacy_policy.section_5_list_1: Contract performance — to fulfill orders and manage your account
privacy_policy.section_5_list_2: Legitimate interests — to improve our services, prevent fraud, and communicate with existing customers
privacy_policy.section_5_list_3: Consent — for marketing communications and non-essential cookies
privacy_policy.section_5_list_4: Legal obligation — where required by applicable law
privacy_policy.section_6_p1: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on our website. Cookies are small data files stored on your device.
privacy_policy.section_6_list_1: Strictly necessary cookies — required for the website to function (e.g., shopping cart, login session)
privacy_policy.section_6_list_2: Analytics cookies — help us understand how visitors use our site
privacy_policy.section_6_list_3: Marketing cookies — used to deliver relevant advertising
privacy_policy.section_6_list_4: Preference cookies — remember your settings and choices
privacy_policy.section_6_p2: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time through our Cookie Settings link in the footer.
privacy_policy.section_7_p1: We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with the following categories of third parties:
privacy_policy.section_7_list_1: Service providers — shipping carriers, payment processors, email platforms, and IT infrastructure providers who process data on our behalf
privacy_policy.section_7_list_2: Analytics partners — to help us analyze website usage and improve our services
privacy_policy.section_7_list_3: Advertising networks — to show you relevant ads, where you have consented
privacy_policy.section_7_list_4: Legal authorities — when required by law or to protect our legal rights
privacy_policy.section_7_list_5: Business transfers — in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, where your data may be transferred as a business asset
privacy_policy.section_7_p2: All third-party service providers are contractually obligated to handle your data securely and only for the purposes we specify.
privacy_policy.section_8_p1: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. Where required, we put in place appropriate safeguards (such as Standard Contractual Clauses) to ensure your data is protected in accordance with applicable law.
privacy_policy.section_9_p1: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, accounting, or reporting requirements. Specifically:
privacy_policy.section_9_list_1: Account information is retained for the life of your account plus up to 5 years
privacy_policy.section_9_list_2: Order records are retained for at least 7 years for tax and legal purposes
privacy_policy.section_9_list_3: Marketing preferences are retained until you unsubscribe or request deletion
privacy_policy.section_9_list_4: Cookie data is retained according to each cookie's set expiry period
privacy_policy.section_10_p1: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:
privacy_policy.section_10_list_1: Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
privacy_policy.section_10_list_2: Correction — request that inaccurate or incomplete data be corrected
privacy_policy.section_10_list_3: Erasure — request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten")
privacy_policy.section_10_list_4: Restriction — request that we restrict how we process your data
privacy_policy.section_10_list_5: Portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
privacy_policy.section_10_list_6: Objection — object to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing
privacy_policy.section_10_list_7: Withdraw consent — where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time
privacy_policy.section_10_p2: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at
privacy_policy.section_10_p2_end: . We will respond within the timeframe required by applicable law.
privacy_policy.section_11_p1: If you are a California resident, you have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA):

privacy_policy.section_11_list_2: The right to delete your personal information
privacy_policy.section_11_list_3: The right to correct inaccurate personal information
privacy_policy.section_11_list_4: The right to opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising
privacy_policy.section_11_list_5: The right to non-discrimination for exercising your privacy rights
privacy_policy.section_11_list_6: The right to limit use of sensitive personal information
privacy_policy.section_11_p2: To submit a CCPA request, contact us at
privacy_policy.section_11_p2_middle: or use the "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link in our website footer.
privacy_policy.section_12_p1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These include encryption of data in transit (TLS/SSL), access controls, and regular security reviews.
privacy_policy.section_12_p2: While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your data, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy_policy.section_13_p1: Our website and services are not directed to individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have inadvertently collected information from a minor, please contact us immediately so we can delete it.
privacy_policy.section_14_p1: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites and encourage you to read their privacy policies before providing any personal information.
privacy_policy.section_15_p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Where changes are material, we will provide a more prominent notice (such as an email notification or a banner on our website). Your continued use of our services after the changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy_policy.section_16_p1: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
privacy_policy.section_16_p2: If you are located in the European Economic Area, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

cookie_policy.heading: COOKIE POLICY
cookie_policy.section_1_p1: Ánimo Run Club ("Ánimo", "we", "us", or "our") uses cookies and similar tracking technologies when you visit our website. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, what types we use, why we use them, and how you can control them.
cookie_policy.section_1_p2_start: This policy should be read alongside our
cookie_policy.section_1_p2_end: , which provides broader information about how we collect and process your personal data.
cookie_policy.section_2_p1: Cookies are small text files placed on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile phone) when you visit a website. They allow the website to recognize your device, remember your preferences, and improve your experience over time.
cookie_policy.section_2_p2: Similar technologies include web beacons (tiny transparent images embedded in pages or emails), pixels, local storage, and session storage. Throughout this policy, we refer to all these technologies collectively as "cookies."
cookie_policy.section_2_list_1_desc: temporary cookies that expire when you close your browser
cookie_policy.section_2_list_2_desc: cookies that remain on your device for a set period or until you delete them
cookie_policy.section_2_list_3_desc: set directly by Ánimo Run Club
cookie_policy.section_2_list_4_desc: set by external services we use (e.g., analytics or advertising providers)
cookie_policy.section_3_1_p: These cookies are essential for the website to function and cannot be switched off. They are typically set in response to actions you take, such as logging in, adding items to your cart, or filling in forms. Without these cookies, our website cannot operate correctly.
cookie_policy.section_3_2_p: These cookies collect information about how visitors use our website, such as which pages are visited most often and whether visitors encounter error messages. The data is aggregated and anonymous. We use this information to improve how the website works.
cookie_policy.section_3_3_p: These cookies allow our website to remember choices you make (such as your language, country, or currency) and provide enhanced, personalized features. They may be set by us or by third-party providers whose services we have added to our pages.
cookie_policy.section_3_4_p: These cookies are set by us and our advertising partners to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant ads on other websites. They track your visits across sites and recognize your device. Disabling them will not stop you from seeing advertisements, but the ads you see may be less relevant to you.
cookie_policy.section_3_4_consent: These cookies require your prior consent. You can change your preferences at any time using our Cookie Settings tool.
cookie_policy.section_3_5_p: Our website includes features from social media platforms (such as Instagram, TikTok, and Spotify). These platforms may set cookies to enable you to share content or interact with their features. We do not control these cookies — please refer to each platform's own privacy and cookie policy.
cookie_policy.cookie_session_id_purpose: Maintains your session state across page requests
cookie_policy.cookie_cart_purpose: Stores the contents of your shopping cart
cookie_policy.cookie_secure_session_purpose: Maintains a secure session token for authenticated users
cookie_policy.cookie_storefront_purpose: Identifies whether the visitor has access to a password-protected storefront
cookie_policy.cookie_ga_purpose: Distinguishes unique users by assigning a randomly generated number
cookie_policy.cookie_ga_star_purpose: Stores and counts page views for a specific property
cookie_policy.cookie_gat_purpose: Throttles the request rate to Google Analytics
cookie_policy.cookie_localization_purpose: Stores your selected country and language preference
cookie_policy.cookie_recently_viewed_purpose: Stores the products you have viewed for "Recently Viewed" features
cookie_policy.cookie_fbp_purpose: Used by Meta to deliver, measure, and improve the relevance of advertisements
cookie_policy.cookie_fbc_purpose: Stores the last ad click attribution data from Facebook
cookie_policy.cookie_ide_purpose: Used to show Google ads based on your browsing on sites using Google services
cookie_policy.cookie_tiktok_purpose: Measures the effectiveness of ads and enables ad retargeting on TikTok
cookie_policy.section_4_intro: The data collected via cookies may be used to
cookie_policy.section_4_list_1: Ensure the website operates correctly and securely
cookie_policy.section_4_list_2: Remember your preferences and settings across visits
cookie_policy.section_4_list_3: Understand how you interact with our website so we can improve it
cookie_policy.section_4_list_4: Measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns
cookie_policy.section_4_list_5: Show you personalized content and relevant advertisements
cookie_policy.section_5_title: 5. YOUR CHOICES AND HOW TO MANAGE COOKIES
cookie_policy.section_5_1_p: When you first visit our website, you will see a cookie consent banner. You can accept all cookies, reject non-essential cookies, or customize your preferences by category. You can update your choices at any time by clicking the "Cookie Settings" link in our website footer.
cookie_policy.section_5_2_p1: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can typically find these options under "Privacy" or "Security" in your browser preferences. Common actions include
cookie_policy.section_5_2_list_1: Viewing cookies currently stored on your device
cookie_policy.section_5_2_list_4: Setting your browser to alert you when a cookie is placed
cookie_policy.section_5_2_p2: Note that blocking certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website, including your ability to add items to your cart or log in to your account.
cookie_policy.section_5_3_intro: You can opt out of interest-based advertising through these resources
cookie_policy.section_5_3_meta_desc: Manage your ad preferences in your Facebook account settings
cookie_policy.section_5_4_p: Some browsers have a "Do Not Track" (DNT) feature that signals to websites that you do not want your browsing activity tracked. Currently, there is no universally accepted standard for responding to DNT signals, and we do not currently respond to them. You can use our Cookie Settings tool to exercise specific choices.
cookie_policy.section_6_p1_start: Some cookies we use may be associated with personal data (for example, if you are logged in to your Ánimo account). In those cases, the processing of that personal data is governed by our
cookie_policy.section_6_p2: Anonymous or aggregated cookie data that cannot identify you is not considered personal data and is used only for analytical and operational purposes
cookie_policy.section_7_p1: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the cookies we use, new legal requirements, or improvements to our website. When we make material changes, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page and, if necessary, display a new consent banner.
cookie_policy.section_7_p2: We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed.
cookie_policy.section_8_intro: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or this Cookie Policy, please contact us
